description: A 1:1 direct-message conversation between two collectors, mirrored to AT Protocol as a real org.swappulse.conversation record. The creator is tracked by authorDid; the other participant by recipientDid so both can read.

recipientDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the other participant

participantDids.description: Both participant DIDs in sorted order for symmetric lookup

lastMessagePreview.description: Truncated preview of the most recent message

lastMessageDid.description: DID of the participant who sent the last message

authorDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the conversation creator
